user.title: Welcome to PlanaVista
user.description:
PlanaVista has been installed successfully.

To complete setup:

1. Navigate to the dashboard where you want your calendar
2. Click the pencil icon (Edit Dashboard) in the top right
3. Click "+ Add Card" and search for "PlanaVista"
4. Save the dashboard

The first time the card loads, a setup wizard will walk you through choosing your calendars, colors, and theme.

Click Submit to finish installation.

household_newer_version.title: Update PlanaVista to change people and PINs
household_newer_version.description: The household file was saved by a newer version of PlanaVista. The calendar keeps working, but people, PINs, and shared screens can't be changed until PlanaVista is updated.

chores_data_missing.title: PlanaVista's chores need a look

chores_save_failed.title: PlanaVista couldn't save chores
chores_save_failed.description: Home Assistant couldn't write a PlanaVista chores file. Check that the disk has free space. Recent changes are kept and are saved once writing works again.
